executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: wrapper/rendering regression between OperationalPipeline result and multicamera UI model
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: adapt the existing typed runtime result once and retain last real analytical state per camera

findings.title: Detection count read from a non-existent event field
findings.mechanism: the wrapper reads event.detections although the canonical count is event.metadata.detections
findings.root_cause: presentation adapter does not follow InferenceEvent contract
findings.recommended_fix: read the bounded count from canonical event metadata

findings.title: Latest frame erases last real analytical result
findings.mechanism: policy-skipped frames publish empty analytics and overwrite track, temporal, behavior and evidence before Tk polling
findings.root_cause: video latest-wins state and sparse analytical state share destructive replacement semantics
findings.recommended_fix: keep video latest-wins while retaining only the last real bounded analytical values

findings.title: Autostart runtime never enables Stop
findings.mechanism: the button is enabled only by the legacy manual-start handler, which multicamera mode never calls
findings.root_cause: legacy control lifecycle is reused without multicamera state synchronization
findings.recommended_fix: derive control state from poll_state and hide legacy source selectors in multicamera mode

findings.title: Evidence button targets a legacy directory
findings.mechanism: UI opens data/evidence while PersistentEvidence writes data/runtime_evidence
findings.root_cause: presentation path is hard-coded outside the configured evidence contract
findings.recommended_fix: resolve and open the configured runtime evidence root

ordered_fix_plan.goal: canonical result adapter and bounded per-camera trace
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: it repairs the first broken boundary
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: real analytics reach the UI model

ordered_fix_plan.goal: separate latest video from sticky sparse analytics
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: operator can observe real tracks, temporal state and signals

ordered_fix_plan.goal: synchronize Stop, legacy controls and evidence path
